documents.doc-cz-os-pro-2026-09-14-15-nt-3104-2026: On 14 September 2026, under ref. 15 Nt 3104/2026, the Prostějov District Court informed Dušan Dvořák that this file will be used to hear his application to reopen the proceedings previously conducted under file 2 T 104/2010. The letter is a procedural clarification identifying the reopening case; it does not itself grant reopening, decide the merits, create a new remedy or start a separate new timer.
documents.doc-cz-os-pro-2026-09-14-15-nt-3106-2026: On 14 September 2026, under ref. 15 Nt 3106/2026, the Prostějov District Court informed Dušan Dvořák that this file will be used to hear the application to reopen proceedings previously conducted under file 2 T 65/2011. The Court also stated that, in the original case, the public prosecutor withdrew the indictment and the criminal proceedings were subsequently discontinued. The letter is a procedural clarification; it does not itself grant reopening, decide the merits, create a new remedy or start a separate new timer.
